newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian cotton prices unchanged in latest week.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian cotton prices unchanged in latest week.

text.p: The Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association said on Monday it left cotton export prices unchanged in this 42nd week of the 96/97 marketing season.
The export market has been very quiet for several months, with only about 1,000 tonnes sold since late March, the association's figures showed.
Total exports in the first 41 weeks of the season amounted to 63,963 tonnes. There were no sales in the 41st week.
The prices, valid until 2100 GMT on July 5, are listed below in centilibres (U.S. cents per lb).
FG/EX FG+1/4 FG FG-1/4 G/FG G+3/8
Note - FG/EX = fully good/excellent, G/FG = good/fully good -Cairo newsroom +20 2 578 3290/1
